statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-45799 (GHSA-7xpr-hc2w-34m9, CWE-129, CVSS 7.5 availability-only DoS) is in com.squareup.wire.ProtoReader.skipGroup() / ByteArrayProtoReader32.skipGroup(): when skipping an unknown START_GROUP field the sub-field length is read as a signed varint without rejecting negative values, so a ~10-byte crafted protobuf payload underflows the position counter and throws an unchecked ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException. The flaw is reachable only when the application decodes adversary-controlled protobuf wire-format bytes through Wire's runtime decoder (ProtoReader / ProtoAdapter.decode). In this image wire-runtime-jvm 5.2.0 is a passive passenger in the Spring Boot fat jar (BOOT-INF/lib): the full Square Wire toolchain (wire-compiler, wire-java-generator, wire-kotlin-generator, wire-swift-generator, wire-schema, wire-runtime) is pulled in transitively by software.amazon.glue:schema-registry-serde:1.1.25 as code-generation / .proto-schema-text parsing machinery, and in the upstream gradle.lockfile every com.squareup.wire artifact is scoped to runtimeClasspath only and never to compileClasspath. The mce-consumer decodes its Kafka MetadataChangeProposal_v1 payloads as Avro via the Confluent Schema Registry (kafka-avro-serializer 8.1.0 -> Avro GenericRecord -> EventUtils.avroToPegasusMCP); KafkaEventConsumerFactory is hard-typed to GenericRecord and AwsGlueSchemaRegistryFactory hardcodes dataFormat=AVRO, and no kafka-protobuf-serializer is present in the jar. An exhaustive scan of the shipped jar's 576 bundled libraries found no class outside com.squareup.wire itself that references ProtoReader / ProtoAdapter; the only transitive importer, AWS Glue's ProtobufWireFormatDecoder, decodes message bytes with com.google.protobuf (CodedInputStream / DynamicMessage) and uses Wire solely to parse .proto schema text. The vulnerable skipGroup() runtime decode path is therefore never invoked on any input in this image. This reachability basis is specific to the current architecture: if a future release adds a Confluent protobuf serializer, flips the Glue serde to PROTOBUF mode, or the Glue serde begins decoding message bytes via Wire's ProtoAdapter, this justification must be revisited.

CVE-2026-45799 (GHSA-7xpr-hc2w-34m9, CWE-129) is an unchecked array index in com.squareup.wire.ProtoReader.skipGroup(): when skipping an unknown START_GROUP field the sub-field length is read as a signed varint without rejecting negative values, so a crafted protobuf payload underflows the position counter and throws an unchecked ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException (availability-only DoS). It is reachable only when an application decodes adversary-controlled protobuf wire-format bytes through Wire's runtime decoder (ProtoReader / ProtoAdapter.decode). Reachability in this image: gradle dependencyInsight on the runtimeClasspath shows wire-runtime-jvm is pulled into a single plugin, data-prepper-plugins:kafka-plugins, transitively via software.amazon.glue:schema-registry-serde:1.1.24 -> com.squareup.wire:wire-compiler:5.2.0 -> wire-kotlin-generator / wire-java-generator -> wire-runtime. It is the Wire schema-to-code generator (a build/codegen tool) leaked onto the runtime classpath by the Glue serde, not a runtime protobuf decoder. The Glue Schema Registry serde that data-prepper's kafka plugin uses handles Avro/JSON schemas; no data-prepper code imports com.squareup.wire (verified by scanning the source tree) and no pipeline decodes untrusted protobuf through Wire's ProtoReader. The vulnerable skipGroup path is not on any code path the image exercises. No upstream fix is published for 5.2.0 at scan time.

wire-runtime-jvm 5.2.0 is a transitive dependency from upstream DataHub GMS 1.4.0.3. The legacy wire-runtime-jvm coordinate has no fixed version reported by Scout; the upstream replacement path is a migration to com.squareup.wire:wire-runtime 6.3.0 or later. Investigating a safe migration path that does not break DataHub compatibility.

CVE-2026-45799 is a missing negative-length check in com.squareup.wire ByteArrayProtoReader32.skipGroup() and ProtoReader.skipGroup() that throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException outside the documented IOException boundary when a crafted protobuf payload includes an unknown START_GROUP field with a negative LENGTH_DELIMITED varint. DataHub's mae-consumer never calls ProtoAdapter.decode (no com.squareup.wire imports anywhere in datahub-project/datahub at v1.5.0.7) and consumes only Avro-serialized Kafka events (MetadataChangeLog, MetadataAuditEvent, PlatformEvent) via Confluent kafka-avro-serializer; its only HTTP surface is Spring Actuator on the bootJar. wire-runtime-jvm 5.2.0 lands on the runtimeClasspath (not compileClasspath) purely as a transitive of the wire-compiler codegen toolchain pulled in by the Pegasus/Gradle plugin graph; the JAR is shipped but no DataHub or Pegasus code reaches its decoder (LinkedIn rest.li ships its own com.linkedin.data.protobuf.ProtoReader and does not depend on Square Wire). Upstream marks wire-runtime-jvm as discontinued with no patched release; the supported replacement com.squareup.wire:wire-runtime fixed in 6.3.0 is not on DataHub's dep graph and a forced upgrade would not affect a code path that is never invoked.
